description: This file contains methods for managing files within the application, including saving, retrieving, copying, moving, and handling file info, specifically for a project related to 'focalboard'. It interacts with file storage backend and manages file metadata.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct that manages file operations and interactions with storage backend.

methods.name: SaveFile
methods.description: Saves a file to storage, generating a new filename or using a template name, and stores file info.

methods.name: GetFileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves file metadata information based on filename.

methods.name: GetFile
methods.description: Retrieves file info and a reader for the file if it exists.

methods.name: GetFilePath
methods.description: Determines the file path based on file info or constructs it from IDs.

methods.name: GetFileReader
methods.description: Provides a reader for the file, moving it from old location if necessary.

methods.name: MoveFile
methods.description: Moves a file from one path to another within storage.

methods.name: CopyAndUpdateCardFiles
methods.description: Copies files associated with a board's blocks and updates their file info in the database.

methods.name: CopyCardFiles
methods.description: Copies files attached to blocks, creating new file info entries, especially for templates.
